Hello everyone,
This is the development team of Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost.
On February 8th, Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost celebrated its first anniversary!
From the end of the smartphone version’s service to reaching this milestone, it has all been made possible thanks to your support and encouragement. We sincerely appreciate it—thank you so much!

Following this time's update, our development team will continue working hard to bring you even more enjoyable content. We look forward to your continued support!

notes.title: "Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost" Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Finally, on Thursday, February 8th, the "Touhou Project" officially approved derivative game "Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost" is now on Steam!

To coincide with the release, the first round of additional music DLC containing 25 tracks, including the original "Love-colored Master Spark," is being released as well.
The amazing collaboration track "U.N. Owen Was Hero?" by Toby Fox & ZUN is also being distributed as a DLC, for FREE!

The Standard Edition of "Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost," with 68 tracks including some of the originals, is priced at 3,960 yen (tax included), and the Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes all 4 additional music DLCs delivering a total of 102 tracks, along with the original soundtracks, is priced at 9,980 yen (tax included).

Don't miss the new start of Dankagu revived as "Phantasia Lost"!
